# Burke Lab Genomics Analysis Toolkit

## A collection of functions and scripts to extract information from a SNP table generated by the Burke Lab Genomics Pipeline

This repository contains an analysis toolkit for genomic SNP tables generated by the Burke Lab pipeline. I did this for the first project of my PhD program. I expect to recycle a lot of code for my second project, even though most of the code here is not optimized at all. In the future, I may want to optimize functions and turn this repo into a package.

The steps are roughly the following:
- Install required packages using renv
- Read .txt SNP tables
- Filter SNPs based on coverage and MAF
- Run CMH tests
- Run Permutation tests
- Creates a PCA plot
- Create phenotype figures

## How to use this repository
Clone it, add your data, and run the functions! Keep in mind that some names may be hard-coded for my project.
